title: KernelLake GPU Memory (OTel)
description: src/memory/gpu_memory_metrics_otel.cpp's kernellake.gpu.memory.* instruments (see docs/OBSERVABILITY.md §2.2.1), one series per gpu.device.id. Prometheus names verified for real against this stack (its OTel bridge inserts the unit suffix from the raw dotted name, then appends _total for counters, after stripping any pre-existing trailing _total from the base name first): kernellake_gpu_memory_allocated_bytes (gauge), kernellake_gpu_memory_peak_bytes (gauge), kernellake_gpu_memory_allocations_total / _deallocations_total / _allocation_failures_total (counters), kernellake_gpu_memory_allocated_bytes_total (counter, cumulative -- note this is the 'allocated_total' metric, not 'allocated').
